relationships.entry_angle: Propose a practical discussion about in-reading contextual interventions and a small Slovenian civic-tech pilot; do not lead with funding.

relationships.value_for_organisation: A working browser demonstrator and a new intervention format that can extend existing digital-literacy work.

relationships.entry_angle: Propose taxonomy review, Slovenian examples and a limited reader pilot focused on independent judgement rather than truth ratings.
relationships.value_for_project: Fact-checking expertise, editorial validation, verified examples and information-integrity credibility.
relationships.value_for_organisation: A reader-facing tool and research environment that complements fact-checking without replacing editorial judgement.
relationships.next_action: Await reply; follow up if no response.

relationships.entry_angle: Propose an Education Mode pilot with teachers or older students, beginning with a low-risk co-design discussion.
relationships.value_for_project: Access to media-literacy practice, teachers, educational framing and age-appropriate testing.

relationships.next_action: Hold until first-wave youth and research partners are contacted.

relationships.entry_angle: Propose a small reader-experience or research-mode pilot on long-form investigative material, respecting editorial independence.

relationships.next_action: Hold until first-wave outreach is sent.
